```python
# SPECTRA design program: 5T OTA preamp + NMOS CS stage (PMOS load) + CMOS inverter
# Polarity: o1 is non-inverting w.r.t. vinp; CS (inv) + inverter (inv) -> vout HIGH when vinp > vinn.
# Current budget (VDD=1.8): iref + I_tail + I_cs ~ 16 uA -> ~28.8 uW (<=39 uW spec).

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (16.0, 12.0, 22.0),   # diff pair + tail + ibias-ref gm/Id; high gm/Id -> small Vov, tail headroom at VCM=0.9
    "L_in":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),      # diff pair / tail / ref length
    "gmid_ld":  (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),    # PMOS load mirror gm/Id (M3/M4/M5 share it -> exact mirror)
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),      # PMOS load length (preamp gain)
    "k_tail":   (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),      # I_tail = k_tail * iref
    "k_cs":     (4.0, 2.0, 6.0),      # I_cs   = k_cs * iref  (CS stage bias)
    "gmid_cs":  (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),    # CS gain NMOS gm/Id
    "L_cs":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),      # CS stage length
    "gmid_inv": (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),    # inverter gm/Id (sets width)
    "L_inv":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),    # inverter length (speed)
    "k_inv":    (6.0, 3.0, 12.0),     # inverter sizing current = k_inv * iref (sets W, not static power)
}

VDD = 1.8
VCM = 0.9


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 2e-6)      # current flowing VDD -> ibias
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)

    I_tail = p["k_tail"] * iref
    I_half = 0.5 * I_tail              # per diff-pair branch and per PMOS load branch
    I_cs = p["k_cs"] * iref            # CS stage current, mirrored from pb
    I_inv = p["k_inv"] * iref
    I_invp = 0.5 * I_inv               # PMOS sized ~2.6x NMOS width for balanced edges

    # ---- device sizing (all mirrors share gm/Id and L with their reference -> exact current ratios)
    op_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], iref, vds=0.6)
    op_t = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I_tail, vds=0.2)
    op_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I_half, vds=0.4, vsb=0.2)
    op_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I_half, vds=0.6)
    op_cl = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I_cs, vds=0.9)   # mirror of op_ld at I_cs
    op_cs = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], p["L_cs"], I_cs, vds=0.5)
    op_iN = lut.size("n", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], I_inv, vds=0.6)
    op_iP = lut.size("p", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], I_invp, vds=0.6)

    # ---- netlist
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op_ref)  # diode ref: IREF sinks through it
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op_t)       # tail mirror (ratio k_tail)
    n.dev("M1", "pb", "vinp", "tail", "vss", op_in)        # drain on diode side -> o1 non-inverting
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", op_in)
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", op_ld)           # diode PMOS load
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", op_ld)           # mirror PMOS load
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", op_cl)           # CS PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "o1", "vss", "vss", op_cs)           # CS gain NMOS (inverting)
    n.dev("MN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", op_iN)         # output inverter (inverting)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", op_iP)

    # ---- first-order predictions
    C_o1 = op_cs.cgg + op_in.cdd + op_ld.cdd               # preamp output node
    C_o2 = op_iN.cgg + op_iP.cgg + op_cl.cdd + op_cs.cdd   # CS output node (inverter gate)
    C_out = cl + op_iN.cdd + op_iP.cdd                     # output node

    t_pre = C_o1 * 0.4 / I_half        # o1 slews ~0.4 V under pair steering
    t_cs = C_o2 * 0.9 / I_cs           # CS output swings rail-to-rail into inverter
    # Inverter full-drive currents at VGS=VDD, VDS=VDD/2 (lut.op with positive magnitudes)
    I_pk_n = lut.op("n", op_iN.W, p["L_inv"], VDD, VDD / 2)["Id"]
    I_pk_p = lut.op("p", op_iP.W, p["L_inv"], VDD, VDD / 2)["Id"]
    t_inv = C_out * 0.9 / max(min(I_pk_n, I_pk_p), 1e-9)
    tpd = t_pre + t_cs + t_inv         # seconds

    # Static power: reference + tail + CS load, plus 10% of I_inv as crowbar allowance
    P_static = VDD * (iref + I_tail + I_cs + 0.1 * I_inv)

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd * 1e9,              # ns
        "power": P_static * 1e6,       # uW
        "offset": 0.0,                 # balanced DC levels, nominal systematic offset ~0
        "polarity_ok": 1,              # vout HIGH when vinp > vinn
    }
```
